title: Marsquake
summary: Ground shaking 4 km north of the crew. Rockfall runout band below the wall is now active; shelters inside it are closed. Re-planning from the crew's position.
source: Scripted event; magnitude comparable to S0976a (MQS V14 catalogue, doi 10.12686/a21); rockfall response from Vijayan et al. 2026

trigger.note: Fires when the crew has walked 6 minutes of its solar-storm route. The storm starts at 60 s, the on-site rule raises the alert about 5.5 s later and the crew takes its first step 60 s (reactS) after the alert, so at_s = 60 + 5.5 + 60 + 360 = 485.5. The engine holds the mission clock at that instant, whatever the demo pacing.
